QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_47

question.text: Under SEBI Box 7.3(i), additional performance benchmarks (beyond the core category-level benchmark) may be created using objectively verifiable parameters. Which set below lists VALID parameters?

answer.text: Investor personality type, fund-manager astrology sign, broker preference.
Instrument of investment, tenure/vintage of the fund, focus sectors.
LP-country GDP growth, GP-family wealth, off-balance-sheet exposures.
Only SEBI-pre-approved parameters from a fixed list of five.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Box 7.3(i): 'Benchmarking Agency shall ensure that such performance benchmarking shall be based on objectively verifiable parameters like instrument of investment, tenure/vintage of the fund, focus sectors, etc.' **The Trap:** A is absurd — no subjective factors. C mixes non-observable and off-ledger items. D — SEBI doesn't mandate a fixed list; the PDF text uses 'like… etc.' **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the same parameter list. Knowing these parameters lets a Cat I/II manager request meaningful customised Performance Reports. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** When commissioning a custom Performance Report, specify 2-3 parameters max (e.g., 'Cat II, vintage 2020, healthcare focus') — too many parameters shrink the peer-set below 5 funds which fails statistical meaningfulness tests.
